name: Tales of the Kinkeeper
source:
The holder of this paper is hereby initiated in the Order of the Golden Quill, pending the successful outcome of a probationary period. He is to replace the retiring Monsignor Bondini as Castle Lagomorfo's spiritual steward, in service to the Lagomorfo family and the community.
May the Divine Thunder preserve you.

[From [url=https://jpde.itch.io/kinkeeper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本文持有者特此被授予金羽毛笔勋章，等待试用期的成功结果。他将接替退休的邦迪尼大主教，担任拉戈莫福城堡的精神管家，为拉戈莫福家族和社区服务。
愿神雷保佑你。

[来自[url=https://jpde.itch.io/kinkeeper]Itch.io[/url]]
